summary: Targeted retest of two bugs from iteration_12.json. Both fixes VERIFIED. (1) /boom-garden third-from-left mode card now reads 'PARROT PERCUSSION' (was 'ECHO STEW'); clicking it navigates into runtime whose GameHeader reads "Who's Got the Rhythm" and 'Parrot Percussion'. Source grep of /app/frontend/src confirms zero 'Echo Stew' / 'ECHO STEW' occurrences (BoomGardenPage.js only has a doc-comment mentioning 'Parrot Percussion (echo): Stew claps...' which does not contain the literal string 'Echo Stew'). (2) /jmatv/variety-show empty state body copy is now 'Fresh episodes are on the way. Check the other shows in the meantime.' — the word 'channel' is gone. Frontend only test as requested; backend skipped.
critical_code_review_comments: App uses HashRouter — future testing agents must navigate via '/#/<route>' URLs (not '/<route>'), otherwise React Router redirects to '/'.
BoomGardenPage.js is 1757 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into smaller mode-specific files.

Welcome-to-JMA modal is gated by localStorage 'jma_player_v1' (from usePlayer.js) — NOT by 'jma_player_name_prompted_v1' as noted in the review request. Setting a jma_player_v1 JSON object is required to bypass, or 'jma_player_name_skipped_v1'='1' also works.
seed_data_creation: None. Set localStorage 'jma_player_v1' to a synthetic player object to bypass Welcome modal during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This project uses HashRouter — always test via https://<host>/#/<route>. Bypass Welcome modal by setting localStorage 'jma_player_v1' to '{"id":"local","displayName":"Tester","createdAt":"<iso>"}' before goto. Set sessionStorage 'jma_audio_unlocked_v1'='1' to skip audio unlock overlay. Both bugs from iteration_12 are fully resolved.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification-only pass, both fixes confirmed.
